name: Ikore AI
tagline: Maize planting and selling decision agent for Oyo State smallholders, delivering grounded recommendations in English, Yoruba, and Nigerian Pidgin.

sponsors.name: Zetaris
sponsors.role: Data layer providing federated SQL queries over the oko_pg catalog (rain_daily, nimet_onset, and price tables) executed read-only per run via DataGateway.

sponsors.name: Meterless H-MEM
sponsors.role: Per-farm long-term memory layer that recalls farm context before deciding, stores each question and advice run, and directly answers 'remind me' recall queries.

sponsors.name: Meterless Nightshift
sponsors.role: Primary AI provider exposing an OpenAI-compatible service through which all LLM calls route without application-side API keys.

sponsors.name: NVIDIA Nemotron
sponsors.role: Model (nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b) serving the understand and explain pipeline steps via Nightshift with thinking disabled, logging the responding model per request.

pre_existing: Meterless agentathon-starter scaffold (Apache-2.0, third-party): initial project scaffolding (.gitignore, images/notebook-loop.svg, notebook.ts, seed/example-session.txt, and initial config/engine/llm stubs committed 2026-10-22)
@meterless/hmem-reference (Apache-2.0, third-party): vendored reference engine in vendor/hmem providing H-MEM memory mining, retrieval, and trust ledger services

Spec pack documentation and seed datasets prepared on 2026-10-21 prior to the 2026-10-22 cutoff (PROJECT.md, DESIGN.md, DATA.md, INSTRUCTIONS.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/oko.mdc, data/crop_calendar_maize_ng.csv, data/farms_seed.csv, data/storage_loss.csv)
